(PER : A.S.Gadkari, J.) :

1) Applicant, accused in Sessions Case No. 744 of 2023, pending on the file of learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge, Belapur, Navi Mumbai, arising out of C.R.No. 454 of 2014, registered with Vashi Police Station, KVM 25 - APL 1368-2023.doc Navi Mumbai dated 18th November, 2014, under Sections 376, 406, 420, 504, 506 (2) of the Indian Penal Code, has filed present Application under Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code for quashing of the said case, with the consent of Respondent No.1, the victim.

entities.text: Vashi Police Station, KVM 25 - APL 1368-2023.doc Navi Mumbai
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2) Ms. Mangla, learned Advocate appearing for the Applicant submitted that, during the pendency of the said Sessions case, due to intervention of the friends and well-wishers, the Applicant and Respondent No.1, have decided to bury their hatches and settle their disputes and differences.

That,
the Respondent No.1 has now remarried and is living her happily married life.
As the Respondent No.1 is giving her consent for quashing of the said crime, the said crime may be quashed.

3) Learned Advocate for Respondent No.1 tendered across the bar her Affidavit dated 7th July,
2023, duly affirmed before a Notary Public.

It is stated therein that due to passage of time, the Respondent No.1 has become more matured and tolerant and has voluntarily come together with Applicant to enter into compromise without any coercion and undue influence.
That, she is now happily married and having a child out of her marital life and wanted to have peace and harmony in her married life.
With a view to forgive the Applicant, the Respondent No.1 also wishes good luck for his future life.
That, their disputes and differences have been accordingly settled and they have decided to bring an end to the present case.

In sub-para (8) of the Affidavit, Respondent No.1 has stated that, this KVM 25 - APL 1368-2023.doc Court may allow the Criminal Application filed by Applicant and quash the Sessions Case No. 744 of 2023 pending on the file of 1st Additional Sessions Court, Belapur, Navi Mumbai.

3.1) Respondent No.1 is personally present in Court and through her Advocate reiterates the contents of her Affidavit dated 7 th July, 2023 and her 'No Objection' for quashing of the crime in question.
4) Perusal of First Information Report and other material annexed to the charge-sheet indicates that Respondent No.1 was a divorcee and had a son aged 8 years when she met Applicant.
Their acquaintance blossomed into an affair and subsequently by extending promise to marry, it is alleged that Applicant established physical relations with her.
Applicant by giving promise to marry with Respondent No.1, established physical relations with her.
The relations between the Applicant and Respondent No.1 appears to be consensual in nature.
